source_refs.summary: **<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Reject asynchronous response policies before transport**

witness_subject.schema_or_environment: Agent4 frozen candidate on unchanged Boundary2/World5; Node26.8.2
witness_subject.input_state_or_trace:
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Reject asynchronous response policies before transport**

When an otherwise valid authored request sets `response_policy.stream` or `background` to true, the adapter forwards that policy even though its only response path reads the body as one completed JSON document. A streaming response is SSE rather than that JSON shape, and a background request can initially return a nonterminal status, so the invocation is misclassified as `malformed_json` or `unsupported_status` after making the provider call. Because the documented adapter supports only normalized nonstreaming execution, reject these policy values as `unsupported_parameter` before I/O or implement the corresponding response handling.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

record.observed_fact: The built-in adapter serializes stream/background true but reads the returned body only as a completed JSON response; unsupported delivery modes are discovered after a provider call instead of being classified before I/O.
